footnotes: From pre-tax loss to net loss: includes $81K from other items, net.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Dec 31, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 29.2% to $1.9M in 2025. Gross margin was 70.3%, versus 46.8% a year earlier, and the operating loss widened to $93.9M from $78.4M.
The net loss widened to $94.1M, or −$2.55 per share, from $76.3M. Operating cash flow was −$77.8M and free cash flow −$79.8M, versus −$63.5M.
sources: Anteris Technologies Global Corp. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
